summary_en: This phase II trial tests adding darolutamide to standard chemotherapy and immunotherapy before surgery, compared with standard therapy alone, in stage II-IIIA androgen receptor positive triple-negative breast cancer. Darolutamide is taken by mouth twice a day for 14 days in the experimental arm, and the standard drugs are given by vein (IV) in 21-day cycles, up to 8 cycles in total, before surgery. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is a phase II trial.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II evalúa agregar darolutamida a la quimioterapia y la inmunoterapia estándar antes de la cirugía, en comparación con el tratamiento estándar solo, en cáncer de mama triple negativo con receptor de andrógenos positivo en etapa II-IIIA. En el grupo experimental, la darolutamida se toma por vía oral dos veces al día durante 14 días, y los medicamentos estándar se administran por vena (IV) en ciclos de 21 días, hasta 8 ciclos en total, antes de la cirugía. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with newly diagnosed breast cancer, stage II-IIIA.
Estrogen receptor and progesterone receptor staining under 10%.
Androgen receptor staining of at least 80% by IHC.
not_for: Breast cancer that cannot be removed by surgery, or that has spread to other sites.
Other cancers (not triple-negative breast cancer) within 5 years, except low-risk or adequately treated cases.
Moderate or severe liver impairment (Child-Pugh Class B or higher).
Heart disease that is clinically significant, myocarditis or pericarditis, or stroke or TIA within 6 months.
